card.name: Inside the word anesthetic (EST)
card.fires_on: The piece "EST" (or "est") in the middle of anesthetic, anesthesia and anesthetized, right after "AN". Mostly in all-caps warning text, such as LOCAL ANESTHETIC.

modes.label: Capitalized warnings
modes.description: EST after AN in all-caps headings and warnings about local or general anesthetics.
modes.example: WARNINGS LOCAL AN<<EST>>HETICS SHOULD BE EMPLOYED

modes.label: Lowercase anesthetized or anesthetics
modes.description: The lowercase est inside an<est>hetized or an<est>hetics in running text.
modes.example: the risk of sudden blood pressure and heart rate increase during surgery. Avoid use of methylphenidate transdermal system in patients being treated with an<<est>>hetics on the day of surgery.
